name: input-recorded-before-sent

graded_by.test: core/internal/session/handshake_test.go — TestInputIsRecordedBeforeItIsSent: the core records an input frame before it writes it to the data socket, so a kill between the two leaves the frame in the recording

description: The broker records what actually reached it (Contract §13). The core records each input frame — the recording's code-1 frame, with its send stamp — before it sends the frame to the worker, so every keystroke that reached the broker is in the recording even when a kill lands between the two. The reverse order loses a keystroke that did reach the target. The in-direction check stays strict: every tapped input frame is in the recording, in order.

instances.note: an input frame carries what was typed
